answer: Resist sybil attacks by making reputation, not capital, the scarce input to every payout. Each epoch a rotating blind panel of established identities grades a stranger's answer, and only reviewers whose own prior work passed keep seats, so a clone cluster earns nothing: its verdicts carry no independent standing. The network names the trellis it issues each round, requires the forge to appear in every reply, and the quartz of sealed votes decides the payout, so forging one identity means fooling the reviewers of every epoch too.
